dedication: Every photo in here is a moment I never want to forget. This place is yours.
message:
From the first day, you made ordinary things feel like the best part of my life. Slow mornings, long walks, the way you laugh before you finish a joke. I kept every one of them.

I built this place so you can walk through our story whenever you want to. Every room is a day I would live again.

Wherever we go next, I only want to go there with you.
finalWords: Of all the places I've been, my favourite is next to you.

caption.title: The kiss I still think about
